final: WITH rating_groups AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length, AVG(CAST(rental_rate AS REAL) / NULLIF(rental_duration, 0)) AS avg_price_per_day FROM film GROUP BY rating), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_price_per_day) AS overall_avg FROM rating_groups) SELECT AVG(r.avg_length) AS avg_running_time, AVG(r.avg_price_per_day) AS avg_price_per_day, AVG(r.avg_price_per_day - b.overall_avg) AS avg_difference FROM rating_groups AS r CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE b.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND r.avg_price_per_day > b.overall_avg
